sf.label: Stockfish 19
sf.method: Baseline: unrestricted MultiPV 3 at every position, 10M nodes, last completed iteration. Candidate comparisons (60M nodes) and deep checks (200M nodes) restrict the root moves and keep their own budgets.

notes.text: The recorded game ends with 28.Rdb1 Qc8 29.Qxc6. If Black accepts with ...bxc6, the b-file geometry lets White use both rooks; this is a strong tactical teaching moment. The arena observed a White-POV cross-node change from +0.58 to +4.95, but that is not a same-root move-regret measurement.
Stockfish 19, 16 Nov 2026 (1 thread, 200M nodes, depth 37, deep check): Nb4 −0.51, played Qc8 −7.49 (mover POV). The catalog alternative is better by 6.98 pawns.
